links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of LLM responses to caregiver tracheostomy questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-4.o FRES 63.78, FKGL 6.41; Claude FRES 36.93, FKGL 10.44 (Claude reading level higher than typical caregiver level)
links.quote: ChatGPT-4.o responses were more readable (FRES = 63.78, FKGL = 6.41) compared to Claude (FRES = 36.93, FKGL = 10.44).

screen.reason: The study evaluates the accuracy, completeness, clarity, and readability of responses from two commercial LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and Claude 3.5/4.0 Sonnet) to caregiver-focused questions regarding pediatric tracheostomy, rated by clinical experts.
